Field/Scenario: Old vs New regime affects deduction-eligible components
Preconditions: Two profiles for same employer/year with different regimes
Test Steps: 1. Create profile with regime=OLD including HRA exemption and Section 80C deduction rows 2. Create profile with regime=NEW with same gross components 3. Compare deduction eligibility/tax computation output
Test Data: regime=OLD vs regime=NEW; identical gross components
Expected Result: OLD regime profile allows deduction-eligible components (HRA exemption
column9: 80C) to reduce taxable income in downstream tax computation; NEW regime profile ignores/ disallows these exemptions per regime rules
column10: resulting in different effective taxable income even with identical grossMonthly
